'''Tempest Scout 2''' was the [[callsign]] of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport]] that took part in the [[Battle of Endor]].

==History==
[[File:AT-ST_SWL.png|thumb|left|250px|AT-ST Tempest Scout 2 active on Endor]]
The [[All Terrain Scout Transport]] designated by the [[callsign]] Tempest Scout 2<ref name="Preview">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stat-tempest-force-battle-force|text=Scene to Stat: Tempest Force Battle Force}}</ref> was active as part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[occupation of Endor]] as part of<ref name="ROJ" /> the [[Tempest Force]] [[legion]], a highly skilled formation of [[soldier]]s who guarded the [[Death Star's shield generator]] as a [[garrison]].<ref name="Preview" /> Tempest Scout 2 was commanded by [[Major]] [[Newland]], while [[Lieutenant]] [[Blanaid]] served as its copilot and gunner. During the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[walker]] was hijacked by [[Chewbacca]] and two [[Ewok]]s, [[Widdle Warrick]] and [[Wunka]], who threw Blanaid overboard and beat Newland unconscious. The three then used the vehicle to destroy Imperial forces, including at least one other AT-ST,<ref name="ROJ" /> and turn the tide of the battle in favor of the Rebel ground forces.<ref name="Insider230">{{InsiderCite|230|Launchpad}}</ref> The walker later rendezvoused with the [[Endor strike team]] after most of the Imperial forces were wiped out. The survivors of the strike team were initially concerned at the AT-ST's arrival as they were unaware of its hijacking by Chewbacca and the Ewoks, until Chewbacca revealed himself to them.<ref name="ROJ" />

Later, [[Han Solo]], while posing as Newland, used the captured walker to trick the commander of the [[Death Star's shield generator]], Major [[Hewex]] into opening the bunker's doors, claiming that the Rebels had fled and the Imperials needed help pursuing them. This was also a ruse to surround the Imperial forces. Hewex fell for the ruse and ordered three squads to help, allowing the Rebels to gain access to the control room once the bunker doors opened and the squads ran outside. As soon as the three squads of troopers exited the bunker, they were forced to promptly surrender after being surrounded by rebels and Ewoks.<ref name="ROJ" />
